stem:
The Venn diagram shows numbers placed in two sets. Set K represents rational numbers, and Set L represents integers. One of the numbers is placed incorrectly.

[Image of a Venn diagram with Set K and Set L inside it.
Set K: -12/2, 7/4, -3/5
Set L: -8, 3, 10]

Which statement shows how to correct the error in the diagram?

options.label: A
options.text: Remove -8 from Set L because it is not an integer.

options.label: B
options.text: Remove 3 from Set L because it is not an integer.

options.label: C
options.text: Move -3/5 to Set L because it is an integer.

options.label: D
options.text: Move -12/2 to Set L because it is an integer.

visual_elements: Venn diagram with Set K and Set L and numbers inside as described
